## 👋 Hi, I am William

A person with great enthusiasm for Electronics Engineering. Dedicated to becoming a professional **Electronic System R&D Engineer**. Bringing diverse, fancy, and cool technologies together to turn components into works of art.

## 🚀 Q&A

- Currently working on: **Master's Degree**
- Recently learning: **TinyML**
- Ask me about: **Circuit & PCB Design, Microcontroller, Firmware**
- Fun Fact: **Avid FPS & Rhythm Arcade Gamer**

## 📌 Experience

- EE Master's Student @ [National Taiwan University of Science and Technology](https://www.ntust.edu.tw/)
- EE Bachelor @ [National Taipei University of Technology](https://www.ntut.edu.tw/)
- Electronic System R&D Engineer @ [Taipei Tech Racing](https://www.instagram.com/taipeitechracing/)
- Undergraduate Researcher @ [Signal Processing & Intelligent Electronics Lab](https://academic.ntut.edu.tw/4628/)
- Undergraduate Researcher @ [Intelligent Control Lab](https://itlabntut.com/home)
- UROP @ [MIT City Science Lab, Taipei](https://www.csltaipeitech.com/)
- Programmer @ [FRC Team 8180](https://www.instagram.com/frc_team8180/)

        <b>2022 @ MIT City Science Lab, Taipei</b><br>
        The Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program (UROP) was a huge turning point in my life. A beautiful laboratory, cutting-edge projects and a great mentor all motivated me to explore different kinds of technologies. The Bionic Robotic Fish Obstacle Avoidance Sonar System was the last project I was in charge of. It utilizes a piezo transducer to transmit/receive ultrasonic waves. A complex system consisting of an AFE, FPGA, and MCU processes the received signals, calculating the distance to obstacles such as walls.
    </blockquote>
